notes.content:
Hi players,

It's been months since the last update, and I've worked hard all day to bring you this new demo version. I hope you enjoy a better experience with these changes!


 Increased the hitbox of The Parasite, making it easier to hit with the bow.
 Arrows now fire from the exact position where you aim your bow.

 Optimized performance for better gameplay.
 Removed all localization due to significant dialogue changes in the previous version. Only Vietnamese and English are now available. A special thanks to all translators who joined the Discord and volunteered to help with the project! 
 Numerous backend improvements.

notes.title: Devlog 13 - More overhauls!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I’m really excited to share some updates with you today.

New Dialogue System
I felt the old dialogue style was a bit outdated, so I gave it a fresh, modern look. Hopefully, it feels more engaging. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/7d8398ab75400ca187101d3a2d9f18744f540be8.gif

Dynamic Weather Changes
Weather is now more than just a backdrop—it’s unpredictable and can even be dangerous. I think this will add a layer of intensity to your travels, keeping you on your toes as you explore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/a1e046f11c6d9b863cdfcdb81c7d07ea57391249.gif

More Side Quests
The main quest is heavily story-driven, but I’m adding tons of side quests to expand the world. These smaller stories give you more freedom to dive into different aspects of the game’s lore and characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/1bc0a8ce3b66a27a3652f0a608a7f6e7e686c80f.gif

Progress Update
One ending still needs to be finalized, and there’s plenty of tweaking and polishing left to do. But progress is steady, and I’m working hard to bring everything together.

That’s it for now! Thanks for following along with the development—it means a lot. Let me know what you think! ⚡

notes.title: Demo 2.5.0 - A better demo
notes.content:
Hi players,

A new demo update has been released with some crazy changes. Please see below.

100% New Dialogues
The dialogues have been reworked completely. Special thanks to An Airborne Cat for helping me with English issues. I'm confident the dialogue in this update is better, more natural, more fluid, and has more emotion attached to each character.

Less Dialogue
A lot of original dialogue has been removed. The demo, originally designed for a 15-minute play, can now probably be finished within 10 minutes. The good thing is that means you can try the combat quicker.

Characters Show More Emotion
Nope, Jack is still chill, but in this update, I've added some details that help with character development.

Tutorial Boss Adjustment
I got feedback about the boss fight being too long and that she had too much health. I reduced her health and added a minor move to ensure she isn't too easy to defeat.

Bug Fixes
A lot of bugs have been fixed, including:
- Location bug when saving/loading game
- Killing "that guy" no longer results in the scenario where he's still alive if you kill him too late.

Thank you all for the feedback. It helped me a lot to improve the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/7f491188a2b10e140b1fead124cbbe866c6ec2c0.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/7231088689b8799eb7d9d506f43f2b254918e751.png

notes.title: Demo 1.3.0 - A huge demo overhaul
notes.content:
After a lot of consideration, we've decided to reduce the demo length from 1 hour to approximately 30 minutes. But, there'll be a very difficult level for you to try the combat of the game.

Below are all the changes.

Dialogues overhaul
We've completely changed the dialogue in the beginning gameplay so it sounds less goofy and more serious.

Special Attacks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/8a85b7e471956ae1ea528e91a991c66fe5a06bc5.gif

Your knife and bow now have special moves that you can trigger by pressing the movement keys + attack key. But, you can quickly access your previous special attack by pressing Ctrl on your keyboard or X if you're using a gamepad.
This is just a test feature. If you enjoy the way to trigger the special attacks, we'll make it official.

An open level for you to test your skill

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/5d394d643df56846155727911430506939073f76.gif

After you've finished the demo (the ending showed up), you'll be transferred to a wide area and you'll be provided with a bow and some creature DNA vials for you to try on your weapons. 

This area is mainly to showcase what the combat is like in Into Samomor. It's quite difficult but we hope it'll be enough for you to have a better understanding of the game's mechanics.

Please update the demo now to enhance your overall experience!

notes.title: Devlog #03 - Dungeons
notes.content:
An RPG wouldn't be complete without exploration, and in the case of Into Samomor, that means delving into areas known as "pits" or "the underground." 

While the surface world may appear deceptively normal—save for the morally questionable requests from its inhabitants—the realm that lurks beneath the forest is a stark contrast, embodying an entirely different set of rules and dangers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/30ced56a62daae43449393a52cf8f2704d7a69db.gif

We're keeping most of the details under wraps until the full version is released, but here's a sneak peek into the unsettling world of the underground.

notes.title: Devlog #01 - Monster DNA, Combat overhaul
notes.content:
I'm working hard to improve and create features that make combat more interesting and offer more customization options, one of which is the Monster DNA feature.

After you defeat a large monster, such as a boss, you will be able to collect its DNA. If you implant this monster's DNA into yourself, you'll gain its abilities. Let the GIFs below better illustrate what I'm talking about.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/235e74a9a778e0952a463baaabaf7dc80a8bf41e.gif

Monster DNA will be collected in a glass bottle. The more bottles and implantations you have, the stronger you become and the more special abilities you acquire. By default, at the beginning of the game, you can only implant one DNA.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/c01a2a21c709e102118eb050511b352c0f35e606.gif

Each monster will offer two types of DNA, and you'll only be allowed to choose one. Depending on whether you want to play as an archer or a melee player, you'll need to make your choice carefully because once you choose, the other option will disappear forever.

And that's the main content for this devlog. Please follow and wishlist the game to keep track of upcoming features that I'll be introducing into the game.
